import hashlib,os,stat
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/Users/qianqi/heptabao-mac-authbus-r2-recovery-preparation-20261106-r2/recover_r2_qa_once.py')
fd=os.open(p,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK)
try:
    first=os.fstat(fd)
    assert stat.S_ISREG(first.st_mode) and first.st_uid==501 and first.st_nlink==1 and stat.S_IMODE(first.st_mode)==0o600
    assert 0 < first.st_size <= 65536
    raw=os.read(fd,65537)
    ident=lambda s:(s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_uid,s.st_gid,s.st_mode,s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns)
    assert len(raw)==first.st_size and not os.read(fd,1) and ident(first)==ident(os.fstat(fd))==ident(p.lstat())
finally:
    os.close(fd)
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='9dbdfd913b97d719ee6db710ce6b492df37147339f8988fb40bf83f3db0937d0'
exec(compile(raw,str(p),'exec'),{'__name__':'__main__','__source_sha256__':'9dbdfd913b97d719ee6db710ce6b492df37147339f8988fb40bf83f3db0937d0'})
